quizName:
Hardest Questions in Iowa
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Orange signs are used to warn drivers about construction work zones.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange and diamond-shaped. Many are also reflective so drivers can see them at night.

questions.question: Drivers should stay a safe distance away from cyclists.
questions.explanation: Drivers must be careful around cyclists and keep a safe distance from them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: Like alcohol and other drugs, drowsiness can:
questions.explanation: Lack of sleep causes poor driving. Drowsiness slows reaction time, reduces awareness, and impairs judgment just like drugs and alcohol do.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. The sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle. You should:

options.text: Not worry because all vehicles are the same.
Not tell your friend you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Ignore any obvious problems so your friend is not embarrassed.
Take a few minutes to learn how to use all the vehicle's equipment before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn how to use all the vehicle's equipment before driving.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, take time to learn where and how to use the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn. Fix any problems before you drive.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel. Any of these can cause a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You may complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with sirens and flashing lights approaches, the driver should pull to the right side of the road and let it pass.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with lights and/or sirens approaches, you must move to the right side of the road right away and let it pass.

questions.question: You should slow down in which situations?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: You should slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp curves, near pedestrians, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light, go for a green light, or yield to cross traffic.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, what must you do?

options.text: Always signal your intentions, even when no other vehicles are nearby.
Signal only if other vehicles are visible.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only when driving in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal your intentions, even when no other vehicles are nearby.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from a curb. Do not skip signaling. Make it a habit to follow this law every time.

questions.question: You are angry after an incident at work. What should you do before driving?

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you stop thinking about it.
Drive fast on the highway to release your anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before you start driving.
Stop at a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before you start driving.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, take time to calm down before driving. Driving while angry is dangerous to you and others on the road.

questions.question: Cell phones can be a serious source of driver distractions.
questions.explanation: Do not use cell phones, computers, or other devices while driving, except to report a crash or emergency. Keep your full attention on the road.

questions.question: You had an argument with someone and feel angry. What should you do?

options.text: Play the radio loudly while driving so you won't think about it.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Drive on the highway to release your anger.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Your emotions affect your ability to drive safely. If you are angry, upset, scared, or worried, calm down before driving. You need to focus on the road, not on what upset you.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, what must you show the officer?
questions.explanation: You must have your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance in your vehicle at all times. You must show all three documents when stopped.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign with black markings is a traffic law sign. You must obey it. This sign means passing other vehicles is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This traffic law sign tells drivers that U-turns are not permitted in this location.

questions.question: If you feel drowsy while driving, what should you do?
questions.explanation: If you feel tired while driving, stop at a rest area to take a nap, stretch, or let someone else drive. Caffeine pills and energy drinks are not a safe replacement for rest.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol harms your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: To avoid panic stops:

options.text: Watch for hazards well ahead of you on the roadway.
Drive with your window partly down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for hazards well ahead of you on the roadway.
questions.explanation: Watch well ahead of your vehicle for hazards. Give yourself space to react. This helps you avoid sudden stops or turns.

questions.question: If you must make an emergency stop on an interstate, you should:

options.text: Sound your horn at passing cars to get their attention.
Get out of your vehicle and flag down the first vehicle that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle, if you can.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle, if you can.
questions.explanation: Pull off the road and turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers. Stay inside your vehicle if you can. Walking or standing on an interstate is very dangerous because of fast-moving traffic.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal three to four seconds before you turn. This warns other drivers.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:
questions.explanation: The safest choice is to stay out of an aggressive driver's way. Never try to compete with other drivers.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and places where you are not allowed to enter. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing lights?

options.text: Drive around the gates if you don't see a train.
Stop completely behind the gates. Wait until the tracks are clear and the gates lift before driving.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely behind the gates. Wait until the tracks are clear and the gates lift before driving.
questions.explanation: You must stop at railroad crossings with warning signs, lights, or flaggers. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They warn drivers of hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. Drivers must follow these rules. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, Disabled Veteran license plates, or disability placards.
